summary: Nativ: Run AI models locally on your Mac Prince Canuma is the developer behind the excellent MLX-VLM Python library for running vision-LLMs using MLX on a Mac. It's similar in shape to LM Studio, providing both a chat interface and a localhost API server for accessing models.
